name: Jeff Angel
source:
A "difficult" customer living in Room 213 (Trust). 

[Spoiler]After learning about he's father's connection to the criminal group Nile, he broke into his safe, stole $20,000, his gun, and car. On the way he picked up [url=/c142666]Mila Evans[/url] and brought her to Hotel Dusk.[/spoiler]

[Based on the [url=https://cing.fandom.com/wiki/Jeff_Damon]wiki[/url]]
